title: Smart City Infrastructure & Structural Engineering Lead
description: Oversee commercial real estate development, smart city transit networks, structural engineering, and municipal civil construction.
details:
### Role Overview
Lead large-scale urban infrastructure projects including commercial real estate, smart transit hubs, and civil engineering works.

### Key Responsibilities
- Review structural designs, Building Information Modeling (BIM) workflows, and MEP blueprints.
- Manage project timelines, municipal approvals, safety audits, and vendor management.
- Direct site engineers on heavy civil foundation, transit planning, and structural integrity.

### Requirements
- Degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering.
- 8+ years of structural experience in urban infrastructure, high-rise, or transit projects.
